title: test_clearance writes every fixture file LF, so a ticket it rewrites reproduces its bytes on Windows
intention: Every write_text in test_clearance.py passes newline='\n', so its ticket, charter and probe fixtures are LF bytes on every box and rewrite_ticket can reproduce a fixture ticket's serialisation on Windows.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 on akiendell, house checkout: test_a_refused_boat_LANDS_AT_FIXME_carrying_every_lack (test_clearance.py:2042) fails because _fixme_world_ticket (line 1998) writes a CRLF ticket and clearance's _send_to_fixme then fails with IllegalTransition 'the ticket's serialisation cannot be reproduced'; it was red before 3d796b46f449, masked on 11-12 by a local LF force.
traces_to: Law 3 and Law 9: a tooth that is green only under a doctored interpreter was never measured green; CP4 resolves the chafe.
how: Add newline="\n" to every write_text call in test_clearance.py; one ast proof asserts it for every call in the file, so no fixture write is left to be found one at a time.

clauses.claim: every write_text call in test_clearance.py passes newline='\n' (ast), where 14 of 16 write_text/write_bytes calls did not

decisions.text: D1: newline="\n" on every write_text in test_clearance.py.
D2: one ast proof, one tooth per clause; red first.

measured.saw: tester run of the :2042 scenario printed: boat sent to FIXME but its ticket write failed (IllegalTransition: the ticket's serialisation cannot be reproduced). A probe: write_text default -> CRLF -> rewrite_ticket raises; newline='\n' -> rewrites. test_clearance.py holds 16 write_text/write_bytes lines (638, 807, 1184-1189, 1335, 1342, 1640, 1716, 1843, 1998, 2208); only 411 and 1669 were forced by 3d796b46f449. No sitecustomize is installed in any interpreter on this box now.
measured.how: bin/cairn test over a scratch proof printing _refuse_at_proved; python probe; grep -n write_text; import sitecustomize in three pythons
